5415896.variantName: Habitat 200 Warm White LED Christmas Tree Lights
5415896.sourceDescription: Bring the warm glow of 200 LED lights to your Christmas or Diwali celebrations. These warm white battery-operated string lights work indoors or outdoors, giving you the freedom to dress up your space wherever you fancy. They come with 8 functions to choose from, flashing and fading and twinkling through different patterns, or you can keep them steady if you prefer a constant glow. The timer feature turns them on for 8 hours and off for 16, so you can set them once and let them do their thing. It's especially handy if you've got them outdoors and don't fancy heading out every evening to switch them on. The cable gives you plenty of lit length to work with, with bulbs evenly spaced along the strand to create a beautiful sparkle. . x4dh8kva.baseName: Walplus Artificial Christmas Tree - Gold - 181 cm
x4dh8kva.variantName: Walplus Artificial Christmas Tree - Gold - 181 cm
x4dh8kva.sourceDescription: This Modern Metal Christmas tree exemplifies contemporary elegance, combining the simplicity of minimalist design with the charm of holiday cheer. Styled in a gleaming gold hue and a matte finish, it presents a tasteful blend of style and simplicity suited for any modern home setting. Its sleek form and contour make it an ideal centerpiece for living rooms or hallways, blending seamlessly into any seasonal decor scheme. Tailored for the modern holiday enthusiast, it projects a festive yet understated aura that is both captivating and inviting. Materials: Made from powder-coated steel, this Metal Christmas tree stands out with its robust, abrasion-resistant qualities. The selection of material not only contributes to a sleek modern look but ensures durability and lasting use through several festive seasons. Included Components: The tree features an integrated sturdy steel stand, providing reliable stability to keep it firmly upright. This component minimizes the need for additional supports, making setup straightforward and quick. Features /Function /Design: The tree embodies modern design, offering clean lines and minimal ornamentation. Its gold matte finish enhances its visual appeal, giving a chic touch to traditional Christmas decor while maintaining a functional and practical setup. Recommended Uses: This tree is perfect for both living room and hallway spaces. Its refined elegance easily transforms any indoor or sheltered outdoor area into a festive environment, allowing you to celebrate in style, whether you're entertaining guests or enjoying a quiet holiday. Care &Maintenance: Assemble the tree according to the manufacturer's instructions. Once the festive season is over, disassemble and store it carefully to preserve its condition for future use. Product Specifications Colour: Gold Material: Powder-coated steel Tree height: 181 cm Stand size: 68 x 30 cm Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery contains: 1 x Metal Christmas tree • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

nn2k83yq.sourceDescription: The pre-lit Ultra Devonshire half tree is a fantastic tree, both for its space-saving properties and for its easy assembly, thanks to the ready-lit warm white LEDs on the outer branches. A half tree version of our best-selling Ultra Devonshire range, these voluminous wall trees take up half the space without scrimping on festive spirit! Including a high-quality mix of PE branch tips on the outer layer & traditional PVC branch tips on the inner layer, it's easy to see why our customers love this ultra-realistic half tree range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase.
